findings: The captured task-event-heavy profile identified full-snapshot JSON serialization as the dominant self-CPU cost.
A conservative size ledger avoids serializing every published snapshot while preserving the exact protocol ceiling.
Safely bounded build and log records avoid a full transactional snapshot clone; validation-sensitive variants retain clone-before-apply behavior.
Attached clients catch up through bounded incremental replay instead of repeated snapshot replacement.
One encoded event frame is reused for identical attached-client fanout in a daemon service slice.
The remaining unbounded supervisor ingress and terminal starvation are explicitly deferred to PERF-IPC-BACKPRESSURE-001.
